subject: SIG questionnaire: evidence reconciliation for Insurely procurement
messages:
From: Emily Stone <emily@insurely.com>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.ai>
Cc: Insurely Procurement <procurement@insurely.com>
Date: 2027-03-21T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: SIG questionnaire: follow-up and evidence ask

Hi Grace,

Thanks again for the walkthrough yesterday. Procurement asked us to collect evidence to close a few SIG items before scoping the contract. We have the SIG v2023.1 questionnaire in hand and a handful of control items that need substantiation for our legal/compliance review. Can you confirm whether you can provide the following by next Friday (2027-03-28)?

- Control mapping: table that maps SIG control IDs to Redwood control owners and evidence artifacts.
- Audit logs: an example of retention-preserving audit logs covering administrative actions (redacted).
- KMS proof: rotation history for keys used in production (redacted or sanitized).
- Data flow: a high-level logical diagram showing where customer data is processed/stored for Hosted API + Dedicated.
- Retention & deletion: policy doc and a sample data deletion ticket showing complete removal.

Also, procurement asked whether any of these artifacts require an NDA or limited access; please flag anything that is sensitive. If there are known gaps, let us know so we can note exceptions in scope.

Appreciate the quick turnaround — our review window is short.

Best,
Emily
Emily Stone
Senior Procurement Manager, Insurely
emily@insurely.com

From: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.ai>
To: Jasmine Liu <jasmine_liu@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-03-21T10:04:00-07:00
Subject: RE: SIG questionnaire: follow-up and evidence ask

Team — quick sync on Insurely asks. Emily wants a consolidated package by next Friday (2027-03-28). I started a control mapping workbook (attached) that pre-populates SIG IDs against our control references (SOC 2 and ISO 27001).

Priorities / owners I propose:
- Control mapping workbook (tab: owners) — Jasmine to validate control-to-policy links and add doc pointers.
- Audit log samples — Karthik, can you pull a redacted administrative audit log slice and confirm retention window? We should sanitize any tenant-identifying fields.
- KMS rotation history — Karthik, please confirm which KMS project we can export from and provide a rotation csv (redacted). Note that Dedicated customers may have alternate key custody; flag which artifacts apply to Hosted vs Dedicated.
- Dataflow diagram — Marissa, can you produce a simple logical diagram (SVG) that covers Hosted API and Dedicated deployment patterns (include S3, replication, and KMS boundaries).
- Deletion sample — Jasmine, pull a recent deletion ticket (redact customer id) and a short write-up of the retention policy.

Emily asked whether an NDA is required — short answer: we only gate raw log exports and customer-specific tickets. We'll provide redacted exports and share the full artifacts over a secure pre-signed share; we'll call out anything that must be view-only.

I attached the draft control mapping (insurely_control_mapping_v1.xlsx). Please update inline comments and ownership columns by EOD tomorrow so I can assemble the package.

Thanks,
Grace
Grace O'Connor
Senior Manager, Assurance & Compliance
Redwood Inference

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.ai>, Jasmine Liu <jasmine_liu@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-03-21T11:15:00-07:00
Subject: RE: SIG questionnaire: follow-up and evidence ask

Grace / Jasmine — quick notes from infra side:

- Audit logs: We can export admin activity from our central observability cluster (retained 400 days). I'll produce a redacted CSV showing timestamp, action, user-id-hash, resource, and outcome. Tenant IDs will be replaced with hashed values and sampling will be applied to avoid PII. Expected file: "audit_admin_slice_2027-01-2027-03.csv".
- KMS rotation history: Keys are in GCP KMS project redwood-prod-keys. I can run the rotation-history export and scrub full key ids; exported fields will be: key_alias, rotation_date_utc, rotated_by, rotation_reason. Proposed file: "kms_rotation_export_redacted.csv". Note: Dedicated customers with BYOK will be marked as "customer_managed" in mapping and not included in the rotation export.
- Deletion ticket sample: deletion tickets live in Jira under INF-OPS. I'll extract one that completes removal of logs + S3 objects and redact the customer handle.
- Access gating: Raw exports live in a private S3 bucket. For Insurely we'll drop files into a pre-signed share (14-day expiry). Anything they cannot receive unredacted should be flagged.

I'll have the KMS export + a short readme on redaction approach by EOD tomorrow.

Karthik
Karthik Iyer
Security Engineer, Redwood Inference

From: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.ai>
To: Emily Stone <emily@insurely.com>
Cc: Insurely Procurement <procurement@insurely.com>, Jasmine Liu <jasmine_liu@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-03-21T14:31:00-07:00
Subject: RE: SIG questionnaire: follow-up and evidence ask

Emily — thanks for the clear list. Attached is our initial control reconciliation package. Contents:

- control_reconciliation_package.zip (contains below files)
  - insurely_control_mapping_v1.xlsx — SIG v2023.1 mapping to Redwood control IDs, owners, and artifact pointers.
  - soc2-bridge-letter.pdf — statement of coverage for relevant Trust Services Criteria mapped to SIG controls.
  - kms_rotation_export_redacted.csv — redacted rotation history (rotated_by is internal username; key_aliass are obfuscated).
  - network-logical-diagram-v2.svg — high-level logical flow for Hosted API and Dedicated deployment.
  - deletion_ticket_sample_redacted.pdf — redacted Jira ticket showing S3 object removal and DB row tombstoning follow-up.

We uploaded the full package to a secure pre-signed share (14-day expiry): https://redwood-secure-share.example.com/pre-signed/insurely/2027/control_package

Notes / exceptions:
- Dedicated BYOK customers: key rotation artifacts are not included for BYOK tenants; we flagged those controls in the mapping as "customer_managed".
- Raw audit exports: we supplied a sampled, redacted CSV instead of a full unredacted export. If your team requires a different sampling period or fields, please indicate which columns you need and we'll evaluate gating.
- If procurement needs a signed NDA for any of the raw artifacts, we can accept a redacted view first and execute a limited-access NDA for full exports.

Next steps — can you confirm receipt and whether the package meets your intake requirements? If you want an on-call walk-through, we can schedule a brief call (30 minutes) next week; Karthik and Jasmine can join to answer technical questions.

Best,
Grace
Grace O'Connor
Senior Manager, Assurance & Compliance
Redwood Inference
grace_oconnor@redwood.ai
